intelligence.human_view: The end slide is the moment the citizen has something to share — their pages, their world, their Smart Link — and until now there was no way to share it from that moment. The button is the share: one tap, out to mobile, Facebook, email, wherever they live. The design is specified in his words, not approximated: black/obsidian, a white glowing circling orb over it, a white plus in the middle — a beautiful icon, because the first thing a new citizen shares should look like the world they just joined. An orb that circles and glows is a living thing, not a flat shape; the plus in the middle says "more" without a word.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you just finished building your very own world, and on the last page there's a beautiful magic button — black like shiny stone, with a glowing white ring circling around it, and a white plus right in the middle! You tap it, and your world flies out to your phone, to Facebook, to email — to all your friends! One tap, and everyone can see what you made!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — when you've just finished making your beautiful new world, the last page should have a lovely little button, right where your special link shows. It's black like polished stone, with a soft white ring glowing and circling around it, and a white plus in the middle. One tap, dear, and your world goes out to your phone, to Facebook, to email — to everyone you love. The first thing you share should be beautiful, because it's the beginning of your world.
intelligence.naya_view: The end slide gets a plus button where the Smart Link shows — tap to share out. Black/obsidian, white glowing circling orb, white plus in the middle. A beautiful icon for the moment a citizen's world begins.
